title: Tier-1 CROSS ruling form -- one decider ruling on the claims routed to it (R38, R39; PM 2026-11-02)
x_purpose: The first funnel. The claims board (pma_pipeline.py claims) routes each room claim to two reviewers from a different method family and, where one exists, the opposite camp. A reviewer does not restate its own case: it RULES on the claim through its own lens -- CONFIRM, REFUTE or CANNOT_SEE -- with the evidence its method reads, on the weekly / daily / 1-hour grid. registrar.py validate --kind cross --claims claims_board.json checks that the form covers exactly the claims routed to this voice. Code (claims-score) applies the survival rule; no seat sees another's ruling until funnel.json is posted.

ruling.x_note: CONFIRM = my method sees the same thing; REFUTE = my method sees the opposite or the claim fails my test; CANNOT_SEE = my method has no test for this claim or the field is not served (say which in evidence)

evidence.x_note: fields by name with their values, in my own method's terms; never a bracket as the reason (R1)

tf.x_note: R39: the multi-timeframe grid for THIS claim. Each entry <=90 chars: what my method sees on that frame from the MTF block, or 'not served' when the bars are missing (then evidence says so).

stance_after.x_note: my own stance on the NAME after this ruling (R35: recorded beside my blind vote)

changed_mind.x_note: true when stance_after differs from my blind vote on this name

what_moved_me.x_note: REQUIRED when changed_mind is true: the evidence, by field name

x_registrar_extra_checks: rulings cover exactly the claim_ids routed to this voice in claims_board.json (no gap, no extra, no duplicate)
ticker on each ruling matches the claim's ticker
evidence using a bracket as a disqualifier => REJECT (R1)
voice is a decider; a voice ruling on its own claim => REJECT
